question: What is the total revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM order_items

question: How many orders do we have?
How many customers do we have?
Revenue by category
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY r DESC

question: Which region generates the most revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS r FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY r DESC

question: Show the monthly revenue trend
gold_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) AS m, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

question: Orders per channel
gold_sql: SELECT channel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC

question: Revenue by channel
gold_sql: SELECT o.channel, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS r FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY r DESC

question: Top 3 customers by revenue
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, c.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS r FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 3

question: Best selling products
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS u, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY u DESC LIMIT 5

question: Revenue by product
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY r DESC

question: What is the average order value?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(t), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS t FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: Average items per order
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(n), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id)

question: New customer signups by month
gold_sql: SELECT substr(signup_date, 1, 7) AS m, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

question: Orders by day of week
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', order_date) AS d, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY d ORDER BY d
